scope: B1 prompt-projection feature extractor: audit image-dependent vs prompt-independent outputs and implement one vision forward per image with multi-prompt reuse (CPU only)

manifest.image_field_resolution: relative to the manifest directory (datasets/) via evaluation.run_hf_token_reduction.resolve_image
manifest.ordering: all 236 grounding records first, then all 236 pointing records (manifest is NOT image-contiguous: 472 first-occurrence blocks for 236 images)

image_dependent_outputs: block0 patch capture and per-group 4-patch mean group_mean[G,1024]
full dense vision-tower + merger embedding merged_embeddings[G,2560]
per_record_outputs: prompt_embeddings[T,2560] from the raw prompt text only (add_special_tokens=False)
teacher_scores[G] = per-group max cosine over prompt tokens
audit.capture_mechanism: removable forward hook on visual.blocks[0]; unchanged

reuse_contract.grouping: samples are grouped by (resolved path, source_image_sha256) across the whole manifest
reuse_contract.cache_lifetime: only the current image group is resident; capture and image are dropped in a finally block and torch.cuda.empty_cache() runs after each processed group
reuse_contract.index_order: records are buffered and flushed in exactly manifest order by an ordered writer, even though groups are processed in first-occurrence order
reuse_contract.overwrite_semantics: --overwrite truncates the index (mode 'w') and rewrites; resume appends (mode 'a')
reuse_contract.resume_hash_guard: current file sha256 must equal the sha256 recorded for every already-completed sample of that path, else hard fail (DistillationContractError); same-path hash drift within a run also hard fails

covered: same image 2 prompts = 1 vision call + 2 prompt calls
partial resume = 1 vision forward (only pending prompts written)
same path content hash change on resume = hard fail
same path content hash change within a run = hard fail
grouped output equals per-sample legacy reference array-by-array (all five npz arrays)
interleaved image groups still emit index in manifest order
plan_image_groups first-occurrence order and manifest indices
validate-manifest-only imports no transformers/PIL (subprocess import guard)
tests.full_evaluation_regression: python -m unittest discover -s evaluation/tests -> Ran 222 tests OK

expected_savings.claim: structural forward-count reduction only; no measured timing is claimed or fabricated

warnings: No GPU, no real model, no extraction, no training and no inference were run in this task; the 236 forward count is a structural expectation, not a measurement.
Image files are read once per sample for source_image_sha256 (the resume hash guard); this is disk-only and not a vision forward.
The emitted JSONL is manifest-ordered for a fresh run and for prefix-completing resumes; a non-prefix partial resume appends new records in manifest order after the existing prefix.
The frozen manifest pin, npz schema, split contract and teacher/student definitions are unchanged.
next_gate: After the GPU audit passes (no non-owner compute process, >=20480 MiB free, not saturated), run the pinned extraction against datasets/prompt_projection_clean_inductive_v1.jsonl and confirm vision_forwards=236 for 472 records; then train the Wt/Wv projection. Until then no GPU/model work is authorized.
